jobs.title: Operations Director
jobs.description:
At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.
Jabil, Inc. is seeking a proven Operations Director to lead site operations and drive excellence across Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, and People. With oversight of Manufacturing, Quality, Safety, Test, Engineering, and Facilities, this leader will set operational strategy, develop high-performing teams, and ensure the organization has the capability and capacity to meet evolving customer demand. The Operations Director will also serve as a senior partner to Business Unit leadership and customers, driving continuous improvement and delivering sustainable operational results in a complex, high-mix, high-volume manufacturing environment.

What will you do?

Leadership and Organization
- Lead the Operations Manager and all functional managers as direct reports, with a single point of accountability for Site performance across all shifts (24/7 operations).
- Design and adjust the Site organization to support growth, ramps, and long-term site stability.
- Hire, develop, and retain senior leaders. Work with Talent Acquisition on capability requirements and selection criteria for management roles.
- Coach leaders on decision-making, performance management, and accountability.
- Align manufacturing and the functions on shared priorities, and resolve conflicts between them.

Talent Development and Succession
- Own succession planning and bench strength for critical leadership roles across the Site.
- Track turnover, engagement, and organizational health, and put retention and development plans in place.
- Make sure leadership development, training, and standard work are in place and working.
- Build a culture of ownership, accountability, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.

Performance Management and Execution
- Set site goals tied to Business Unit and Sr Leadership and cascade them through the organization.
- Own the Site operating system: KPIs, dashboards, and tiered accountability reviews from the floor to site leadership.
- Give timely, direct feedback to leaders based on performance data and what you see on the floor.
- Make sure performance evaluations across the organization are accurate, fair, and on time.
- Lead the site through ramps, escalations, and disruptions while keeping focus and discipline.

Business Strategy and Customer Alignment
- Turn corporate and Business Unit strategy into executable site plans.
- Align manufacturing, test, and support capacity with customer requirements, demand forecasts, and financial targets.
- Represent the Site with customers in business reviews, audits, and escalations.
- Update Business Unit and senior leadership regularly on performance, risks, and improvement initiatives.

Financial and Resource Management
- Own the Site cost drivers (labor, overhead, and capital) and drive cost reduction and productivity improvements.
- Approve and manage headcount plans, capacity models, and capital investments with Finance.
- Make sure corrective actions are in place and tracked when cost, productivity, or delivery targets are missed.

Technical and Operational Excellence
- Drive continuous improvement through data analysis, KPI management, and structured problem-solving (QRQC, RCA, Kaizen).
- Make sure standard work, procedures, and work instructions are effective, current, and followed in every function.
- Work with Engineering, Quality, and Test to improve process capability, yield, and customer satisfaction.
- Promote best practices and share learnings with other Jabil sites.
- Own Site compliance with Jabil policies, including Safety, Quality, Security, and Confidentiality, as well as regulatory and customer audits.
- Set the tone for a strong safety culture and make sure all health and safety requirements are followed.

How will you get here?

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience. Advanced degree preferred.
- 8-15 years of manufacturing or operations experience, including at least 7 years in a senior leadership role managing managers and multiple functions.
- Hands-on leader who leads from the front and drives culture and change.
- Experience in a complex, matrixed, fast-paced manufacturing environment (EMS preferred), including site ramps or large-scale growth.
- Ability to influence customers, executives, and peers at all levels.
- Strong safety mindset and a record of building a safety culture.
- Working knowledge of operational metrics, labor and capacity planning, financial management, and continuous improvement tools.
- Proficiency with Workday, SAP (ERP/MES), and Microsoft Office.
- Willingness to be on the floor and flex across shifts as the business requires.

BENEFITS PACKAGE WITH JABIL:
- Competitive base salary
- Short Term Incentive Plan
- Medical, Dental, Prescription Drug, and Vision Insurance with HRA and HSA options
- 401K match
- Employee Stock Purchase Plan
- Paid Time Off
- Tuition Reimbursement
- Life, AD&DJBL TA - Job Requisition Process Status, and Disability Insurance
- Commuter Benefits
- Employee Assistance Program
- Pet Insurance
- Adoption Assistance
- Annual Merit Increases
- Community Volunteer Opportunity

BE AWARE OF FRAUD: When applying for a job at Jabil you will be contacted via correspondence through our official job portal with a jabil.com e-mail address; direct phone call from a member of the Jabil team; or direct e-mail with a jabil.com e-mail address. Jabil does not request payments for interviews or at any other point during the hiring process. Jabil will not ask for your personal identifying information such as a social security number, birth certificate, financial institution, driver’s license number or passport information over the phone or via e-mail. If you believe you are a victim of identity theft, contact the Federal Bureau of Investigations internet crime hotline (www.ic3.gov), the Federal Trade Commission identity theft hotline (www.identitytheft.gov) and/or your local police department. Any scam job listings should be reported to whatever website it was posted in.
Jabil, including its subsidiaries, is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If you are a qualified individual with a disability, you have the right to request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access Jabil.com/Careers site as a result of your disability. You can request a reasonable accommodation by sending an e-mail to Always_Accessible@Jabil.com or calling 727-803-7988 with the nature of your request and contact information. Please do not direct any other general employment related questions to this e-mail or phone number. Please note that only those inquiries concerning a request for reasonable accommodation will be responded to.

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.
The Operations Manager leads day-to-day manufacturing operations across the CVG campus, with direct accountability for production leadership, work cells, and shift execution. Reporting to the Operations Director, this role drives daily performance across Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, and People while coordinating closely with Quality, Safety, Test, Engineering, and Facilities to ensure alignment around a single operational plan. The Operations Manager serves as the primary link between the production floor and campus leadership, translating business priorities into disciplined execution and driving timely resolution of operational issues.

What will you do?

Manufacturing Leadership and People
- Lead production managers, supervisors, and work cell leaders as direct reports, with full accountability for floor performance on all shifts (24/7 operations).
- Hire, develop, and retain manufacturing leaders. Work with Talent Acquisition on capability requirements and selection criteria.
- Coach managers on leadership presence, decision-making, performance management, and accountability.
- Track turnover, engagement, and bench strength in manufacturing, and put retention and succession plans in place for critical roles.
- Complete direct report performance evaluations accurately, fairly, and on time. Give the Operations Director input on functional managers' performance.

Cross-Functional Alignment (Dotted Line)
- Align the functional managers (Quality, Safety, Test, Engineering, Facilities) to manufacturing priorities through daily and weekly forums.
- Escalate unresolved cross-functional issues to the Operations Director with data and a recommended path forward.
- Work through peers, without direct authority, to clear the constraints that limit output: test capacity, equipment availability, quality holds, and facility readiness.
- Share priorities and the build plan so every function knows its part in meeting customer commitments.

Performance Management and Execution
- Set clear, measurable manufacturing goals tied to campus and Business Unit priorities (Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, Productivity, and People).
- Own Daily CAC, run tiered accountability reviews and dashboards, and make sure corrective actions are assigned, tracked, and closed.
- Give timely, direct feedback based on performance data and what you see on the floor.
- Lead teams through ramps, escalations, and disruptions while keeping focus and discipline.

Communication and Engagement
- Keep communication consistent and open across shifts, functions, and frontline teams.
- Create forums for two-way communication, ideas, and problem-solving.
- Recognize strong performance fairly and consistently.
- Adjust communication style to reach different teams across shifts.

Business Alignment, Planning, and Cost
- Turn campus and corporate strategy into executable manufacturing plans.
- Align work cell execution with customer requirements, capacity plans, and financial targets.
- Support accurate headcount, capacity, and production forecasting, and compare forecast to actual to spot trends and risks.
- Reduce cost through process optimization, labor efficiency, and waste elimination, and drive corrective action when targets are missed.
- Work with Finance, Engineering, and Quality to balance cost, quality, and delivery.
- Update the Operations Director and Business Unit leadership regularly on performance, risks, and improvement initiatives.

Technical and Operational Excellence
- Drive continuous improvement through data analysis, KPI management, and structured problem-solving (QRQC, RCA, Kaizen).
- Make sure standard work, procedures, and work instructions are effective, current, and followed.
- Promote best practices and share learnings with other Jabil sites.
- Work with Engineering and Quality to improve process capability, yield, and customer satisfaction.
- Comply with all Jabil policies, including Safety, Quality, Security, and Confidentiality, and lead by example on safety.

How will you get here?

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.
- 5-10 years of manufacturing or operations experience, including at least 5 years in a leadership role managing managers or supervisors.
- Hands-on leader who leads from the front and drives culture and change.
- Experience in a complex, matrixed, fast-paced manufacturing environment (EMS preferred).
- Ability to influence peers and functional leaders without direct authority.
- Strong safety mindset.
- Working knowledge of operational metrics, labor planning, and continuous improvement tools.
- Proficiency with Workday, SAP (ERP/MES), and Microsoft Office.
- Willingness to be on the floor and flex across shifts as the business requires.

BENEFITS PACKAGE WITH JABIL:
- Competitive base salary
- Short Term Incentive Plan
- Medical, Dental, Prescription Drug, and Vision Insurance with HRA and HSA options
- 401K match
- Employee Stock Purchase Plan
- Paid Time Off
- Tuition Reimbursement
- Life, AD&DJBL TA - Job Requisition Process Status, and Disability Insurance
- Commuter Benefits
- Employee Assistance Program

jobs.title: Lean Six Sigma I
jobs.description:
At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.
JOB SUMMARY

The Lean Six Sigma works within the Lean Six Sigma department support lean six sigma initiatives to meet company, workcell and customers' goals and objectives.
The Lean Six Sigma aims to provide Lean expertise and guidance through focused and sustainable value stream transformation to enable cross-functional collaboration and best practices sharing and implementation. This role provides continuous coaching and knowledge sharing of Technical Lean Six Sigma and to identify development opportunities over multiple Workcells in promoting continuous improvement across Jabil.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

· Communicate to regional team key lean six sigma metrics for assigned customer(s) and site
· Ensure the standardization of Jabil processes throughout the site in accordance with the global, regional and site direction
· Coach, mentor, and train engineers within the lean team and site on lean principles
· Work closely with the Plant Lean Six Sigma Managers to sustain a Lean culture with Vision and Strategy in the Value Stream Alignment process.
· Provide coaching and support on training, project identification and prioritization
· Monitor, coach, and continuously support value stream transformation initiatives by coaching on Lean principles, tools and methodologies.
· Give guidance, suggestions, and inspiration to Lean Coaches and process owners for optimizing value stream.
· Building a Lean Production System by being the technical mentor and coach towards integration of Lean principles, values, philosophies and tools for driving continuous improvement through coaching and guiding operators over multiple projects
· Work with value stream owners and AOM’s to create a system to ensure everyone is conducting the Lean Principles correctly and
consistently
· Mentor a best practice sharing internal network supported by Lean Principles
· A coach and active facilitator in Bronze/Silver Certification projects and mentoring sessions
· Be an active participant in the Lean Silver Certification
· Lead by example and model the desired behaviors and values
· Foster respect for people and humility through mentoring and coaching through the site’s Lean journey
· Encourage risk taking and experimentation using the scientific method
· Maintain proficiency continuously learning align with Plant LSS Manager and Operations Director
· Align with the local Lean rewards & recognition program
· Align with Finance to bring the impact of projects that are part of Lean efforts into Jabil’s financial processes
· Collect feedback from Lean Coach and propose improvements to process owners
· Seek and value feedback from the team and provide timely help if needed
· Support the Plant LSS Manager to drive actions which will improve Lean Index Assessment score
· Develop and mentor multiple workcell leaders to facilitate and lead Kaizen Events to ensure Cultural Sustainability
· Support Lean Six Sigma Managers to propose and develop a strategy
· Anticipate and meet/exceed customer expectations by solving problems timely and effectively
· Provide statistical problem solving analysis
· Adhere to all safety and health rules and regulations associated with this position
· May perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned

MANAGEMENT & SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

· Typically reports to management or leadership. Direct supervisor job title(s) typically include: Regional Lean Six Sigma Manager or Regional Operations/Manufacturing Management.
·Job is NOT directly responsible for managing other employees (e.g., hiring/termination and/or pay decisions, performance management).

JOB QUALIFICATIONS
KNOWLEDGE REQUIREMENTS

· Bronze and Silver Certified by Jabil or by recognized organization in the industry (e.g. ASQ, SME, Shingo, Prize)
· Project and facilitation experience in a heavily mixed environment
· Experienced in change management, project management, and financial management
· Experienced in financial project cost savings analysis
· Or an equivalent combination of education, training or experience.
· Excellent leadership and communication skills
· Track record showing continual improvement of personal skills
· Ability to write routine reports and correspondence and to speak effectively before groups of customers or employees of organization
· Understand and practice the Lean principles, methodologies and tools
· Advanced PC skills, including training and knowledge of Jabil’s software packages
· Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals
· Be expert in lean tools and processes to coordinate and share knowledge on a regional and global scale

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS

· Bachelor’s Degree in industrial engineering or related discipline preferred
· Minimum 8 years of working experience in the Lean Six Sigma area or related field
· Six sigma black belt and lean certified
· Or an equivalent combination of education, training or experience.

本職位為公司財務數位轉型與 Integrated Solutions 的核心推手，結合深厚的財務分析敏感度與專案管理能力。
您將作為財務團隊與各跨部門單位之間的戰略溝通橋樑，將複雜的財務與營運需求，轉化為具體、可落地且可持續的數位解決方案。

2. 建立專案藍圖並擬定執行計畫，掌握專案資源需求、執行進度、工作項目、差異分析並交付成果。

At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.
Jabil Elmira campus is located in Horseheads, NY. This role will be based on-site (no remote or hybrid structure). We are proud to manufacture Medical Devices for orthopedic specialties including joint reconstruction, trauma, spinal surgery, sports medicine and specialty implants for leading medical technology companies. Our employees are honored to work together with industry leading companies to make a difference in the lives of patients around the world.

Due to continued growth, we are seeking a Site HR Manager to support our expanding operations and workforce needs.

Job Summary
The HR Manager serves as a strategic business partner to site leadership, driving people strategies that support business objectives, organizational growth, and employee engagement. This role leads the development and execution of talent, workforce planning, employee relations, leadership development, performance management, compliance, and culture initiatives that strengthen organizational effectiveness.

The HR Manager partners closely with leaders at all levels to create a high-performance, inclusive workplace while ensuring compliance with applicable employment laws and company policies. This position champions employee experience, organizational capability, change management, and talent development initiatives that enable business success. Will manage the HR team.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Strategic Partnership & Organizational Effectiveness
- Partner with site and functional leadership to develop and execute people strategies aligned with business objectives.

- Serve as a trusted advisor and coach to leaders on employee relations, performance management, talent development, workforce planning, and organizational design.

- Drive organizational effectiveness initiatives that enhance productivity, engagement, retention, and leadership capability.

- Support change management efforts, including restructures, business transformations, and workforce planning activities.

- Leverage workforce analytics and key HR metrics to identify trends, provide insights, and recommend solutions.

Employee Relations & Compliance
- Foster a positive employee experience and workplace culture that reflects company values.

- Lead and conduct complex employee relations investigations, ensuring fair and consistent resolution of workplace concerns.

- Provide guidance on corrective action, policy interpretation, performance improvement plans, and employment decisions.

- Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local employment laws and regulations, including EEO, ADA, FMLA, Wage & Hour, OSHA, and other applicable requirements.

- Partner with Legal, Ethics & Compliance, and external agencies as necessary to mitigate organizational risk.

Talent Acquisition & Workforce Planning
- Partner with Talent Acquisition and site leadership to identify current and future talent needs.

- Ensure effective recruiting, hiring, and onboarding processes that support a positive candidate and new hire experience.

- Develop workforce plans that align talent capabilities with business requirements.

- Support succession planning and talent review processes to strengthen organizational bench strength.

Talent Development & Employee Engagement
- Lead performance management processes, including goal setting, talent assessments, and development planning.

- Drive employee engagement initiatives and partner with leaders to develop and execute action plans.

- Facilitate leadership development programs, manager training, and employee development initiatives.

- Support career development, internal mobility, and succession planning activities.

HR Operations & Continuous Improvement
- Ensure consistent application of HR policies, procedures, and best practices.

- Identify opportunities to improve HR processes, enhance employee experience, and increase operational efficiency.

- Maintain accurate HR records, reporting, and documentation in compliance with company policies and legal requirements.

- Share best practices and collaborate with HR peers across the organization to drive continuous improvement.

Leadership
- Lead and develop HR team members, providing coaching, guidance, and development opportunities.

- Promote a culture of accountability, teamwork, inclusion, and continuous learning.

- Support enterprise-wide HR initiatives and regional people strategies as assigned.

Other
- May perform other duties as assigned.

Education & Experience Requirements
- Bachelor’s degree in HR, Business, or a related field required.

- Human Resources Management Certificate and/or PHR or SPHR desired.

- At least 5-8+ years of experience as an HR Site Leader, preferably in a manufacturing (or similar) environment.

- At least 2+ years of experience managing people.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities
- Ability to read, analyze, interpret and communicate regarding common scientific and/or technical journals, financial reports, and legal documents.

- Ability to respond to common inquiries or complaints from customers, regulatory agencies, or members of the business community.

- Ability to effectively present information to top management, public groups, and/or boards of directors.

- Advanced PC skills, including training and knowledge of Jabil’s software packages.

- Ability to tailor advanced quality tools training to all levels of the organization.

- Ability to calculate figures and amounts such as discounts, interest, commissions, proportions, percentages, area, circumference, and volume.

- Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists.

- Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.

- Strong knowledge of global and regional logistics operations and industry.

- Strong proficiency in determining logistics requirements to enable company’s business goals and objectives with ability to devise and implement strategy to achieve targets.

- Strong financial and analytical ability. Proficiency in managing business analytics to determine optimum company footprint.

- Strong knowledge of international direct and indirect taxes as well as global customs regimes.

- Proven track record of successful change management accomplishments, implementing and management continuous productivity and cost reduction programs.

- Strong and convincing communication skills.

- Proficiency in use of personal computers, Microsoft Office products (Excel, Word and PowerPoint) and e-mail skills required.

- Strong knowledge of federal, state, and local employment laws and regulations.

- Expertise in employee relations, investigations, conflict resolution, and performance management.

- Knowledge of talent management, workforce planning, succession planning, and organizational development.

- Exposure leading change management and organizational transformation initiatives.

- Strong business acumen with the ability to align HR strategy to operational and financial objectives.

- Demonstrated ability to influence and build credibility with leaders at all levels of the organization.

- Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and facilitation skills.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.

- Proficiency with HRIS systems (Workday preferred) and Microsoft Office applications, including Excel and PowerPoint.

- Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

- Demonstrated commitment to employee engagement, diversity, inclusion, and belonging.

The pay range for this role is $103,100 - $185,600. Job-related, non-discriminatory factors used to determine the actual offered rate include qualifications and experience, geographic location, education, external market data, and consideration of internal equity.

As part of the total rewards package, this position is eligible for a short-term incentive based on performance. In addition, Jabil offers benefits to enhance your health, wealth and resilient self. These include medical, dental, and vision insurance plans; 401(k) retirement plan and employee stock purchase plan; and paid time off.

jobs.title: Purchasing Manager
jobs.description:
At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.
How will you make an impact?
Lead the Materials and Purchasing function to ensure material supply meets demand, optimize overall purchasing costs, support business growth initiatives, and develop strategic sourcing and supply chain solutions. Drive operational excellence through supplier management, inventory optimization, cost reduction initiatives, and team development while supporting customer satisfaction and business objectives.

What will you do?
Leadership & Team Development
- Recruit, interview, and hire Purchasing Supervisors and Planner/Buyers.
- Partner with recruiters to identify qualified candidates for Materials and Purchasing roles.
- Coach team members through the hiring and onboarding process.
- Monitor turnover trends and implement retention initiatives.
- Identify individual and team development needs and create training plans.
- Develop and maintain training curricula for the Materials organization.
- Coach and mentor Materials staff to deliver exceptional service to internal and external customers.
- Develop and manage succession planning activities for the Materials function.
- Establish clear goals, objectives, and performance expectations for team members.
- Provide ongoing coaching, feedback, and performance management.
- Conduct performance evaluations professionally and on schedule.
- Drive accountability and continuous improvement against operational metrics and business objectives.
- Coordinate and lead teams through changing priorities and critical business situations.
- Ensure recognition and reward programs are applied fairly and consistently.

Communication
- Facilitate regular team meetings and communication forums.
- Promote the exchange of ideas, information, and best practices within the department.
- Communicate effectively through clear verbal and written messaging.
- Encourage employee engagement and feedback.
- Adapt communication styles to effectively interact with employees at all levels.

Business & Functional Management
- Understand and support campus and organizational strategic objectives.
- Develop and implement Materials strategies aligned with business goals.
- Support Workcell business strategies through effective materials management.
- Provide regular updates to Business Unit Managers, Workcell Managers, and Operations leadership.
- Identify opportunities to streamline processes, eliminate waste, and reduce costs.
- Utilize cost management tools to monitor departmental expenses and identify trends.
- Provide cost analysis and improvement recommendations to stakeholders.
- Develop accurate departmental forecasts and planning assumptions.
- Analyze forecast accuracy and historical trends to improve planning effectiveness.

Materials & Supply Chain Management
- Ensure operational execution aligns with Jabil Supply Chain strategies.
- Support the development and implementation of Supply Chain initiatives and systems.
- Ensure material supply is aligned with customer demand and production requirements.
- Partner with Materials Planners to establish realistic Master Production Schedule (MPS) commitments.
- Maintain disciplined planning processes to ensure material availability while minimizing liability and excess inventory.
- Monitor and resolve material shortages, non-conforming inventory, excess stock, and obsolete materials.
- Drive reductions in overall material costs, including component pricing, freight, inventory carrying costs, and administrative expenses.
- Optimize Material Price Variance (MPV) through strategic sourcing and cost management initiatives.
- Support standard costing activities through accurate component cost projections.
- Ensure customer quotations are competitive while maximizing favorable MPV opportunities.
- Ensure purchase orders are executed according to negotiated pricing, terms, and conditions.
- Partner with Commodity Managers and Buyers to support strategic sourcing objectives.
- Ensure suppliers are selected based on cost, quality, delivery, and overall business value.
- Monitor supplier performance and drive continuous improvement initiatives with suppliers.
- Adhere to all safety and health rules and regulations associated with this position.
- Comply with all procedures within the company security policy.
- May perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

How will you get here?

Education:
- Bachelor’s degree preferred.
- Equivalent combination of education, training, and experience may be considered.

Experience:
- Minimum of five years of experience in Materials Management, Purchasing, Procurement, Supply Chain, Planning, or a related field.
- Minimum of two years of leadership or supervisory experience.
- Experience managing purchasing, planning, inventory management, or supply chain operations in a manufacturing environment preferred.
- Experience developing and implementing materials and procurement strategies preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities:
- Strong knowledge of Materials Management, Purchasing, Supply Chain, and Inventory Control principles.
- Understanding of MRP, ERP, and Master Production Scheduling (MPS) processes.
- Knowledge of supplier management, sourcing, procurement, and contract execution.
- Ability to develop and execute strategic supply chain initiatives.
- Experience managing inventory levels to balance customer demand and operational efficiency.
- Strong leadership, coaching, team development, and succession planning skills.
- Ability to establish goals, measure performance, and drive accountability.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Ability to identify process improvement opportunities and implement cost-saving initiatives.
- Knowledge of standard costing, Material Price Variance (MPV), inventory valuation, and cost management principles.
- Ability to evaluate supplier performance and drive continuous improvement.
- Strong business acumen and decision-making capabilities.
- Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills.
- Ability to effectively communicate and influence employees, suppliers, customers, and leadership teams.
- Advanced computer skills and proficiency using Microsoft Office and business systems.
- Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and
- deadlines.
- Ability to analyze data, identify trends, and develop actionable recommendations.
- Ability to calculate percentages, ratios, variances, and financial metrics.
- Ability to work independently and lead cross-functional teams.
- U.S. Citizenship required for site-specific security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications:
- APICS Certification preferred.
- Certified Purchasing Manager (CPM) Certification preferred.
- Experience leading Materials, Purchasing, Supply Chain, or Procurement teams within a manufacturing environment.
- Experience with strategic sourcing, supplier negotiations, and cost reduction programs.
- Experience supporting high-volume manufacturing operations.
- Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, continuous improvement, and supply chain optimization practices.
- Experience working with global suppliers and complex supply chains.

- Continuous Improvement

With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. How will you make an impact?
The Compliance Manager ensures the established Quality Management System (QMS) complies with the applicable regulations, industry standards, internal, and customer requirements. This role provides leadership for compliance activities supporting aseptic manufacturing and sterile filling operations, ensuring inspection readiness and continuous improvement of quality systems. The Compliance Manager serves as the primary subject matter expert for regulatory compliance, supporting interactions with regulatory authorities and customers while promoting a culture of quality throughout the organization.

What will you do?
- Ensure compliance with current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP), FDA regulations (21 CFR Parts 210 and 211), EU GMP Annex 1, ICH guidelines, and other applicable global regulatory requirements.

- Maintain ongoing inspection readiness for healthcare authorities.

- Lead regulatory inspections and customer audits.

- Coordinate responses to inspection and customer audits observations, including FDA Form 483s, audit observations, and regulatory commitments.

- Monitor changes in global regulations and assess organizational impact.

- Responsible for the Internal Audit program.

- Develop and execute the annual internal audit schedule, conduct audits, track audit findings through effective closure and identify systemic compliance risks and recommend improvements.

- Analyze quality system trends.

- Recommend process improvements that enhance compliance and operational efficiency.

- Provide compliance oversight for aseptic processing and sterile filling operations .

- Ensure compliance with contamination control strategies and cleanroom requirements.

- Participate in investigations utilizing root cause analysis methodologies.

- Promote a culture of quality and compliance.

- Develop cGMP and compliance training programs.

- Mentor departments on regulatory expectations and best practices.

- Support digital quality initiatives and quality system optimization.

- Other duties as assigned by supervisor.

How will you get here?

Knowledge requirements:
- FDA 21 CFR Parts 210 and 211

- EU GMP Guidelines (especially Annex 1)

- ICH Q7, Q8, Q9, Q10

- Auditing

- Root cause methodologies/CAPA

- Data Integrity (ALCOA+)

- Cleanroom classifications (ISO 14644)

- Contamination Control Strategy

- Process and Cleaning Validation

- Media Fill Programs

- Strong understanding of QMS requirements

- Strong critical thinking skills and capable of applying critical thinking to risk-based decisions

Education and Experience:
- Bachelor’s degree in pharmacy, microbiology, chemistry, biology, engineering, or a related scientific discipline.

- Minimum 6 years of pharmaceutical (or similar) industry working experience.

- Minimum 4 years in Quality Assurance or Compliance management.

- Minimum 3 years supporting sterile pharmaceutical manufacturing and aseptic filling operations.

- Experience leading regulatory inspections and/or customer audits.

- Experience leading internal audits.

- Experience working with eQMS systems

Physical Requirements:
•     Ability to travel between and within facilities to visit staff, operations, and projects, as needed.
•     Ability to sit, stand, climb stairs, and climb ladders to mezzanines (when necessary).
•     Ability to lift, up to, 40 (lbs.) pounds on occasion.
•     Ability to use PPE (safety shoes, goggles, respirators, gloves, etc. when necessary).

BENEFITS PACKAGE WITH JABIL
- Competitive base salary

- Medical, Dental, Prescription Drug, and Vision Insurance with HRA and HSA options

- Provide customer sales strategies and monitor their progress.
- Compare forward forecast results to historical actual results for trend assessment and analysis.

- Create customer /product penetration strategies for both new and existing accounts based on product lifecycle analysis.

- 30-40% travel

- Bachelor’s degree in business or related area preferred.
- 5-7 years Jabil, OEM or comparable contract manufacturing experience preferred or a combination of education, experience, and/or training.

We are seeking a highly analytical and system-oriented Compliance Specialist, Technology to support Jabil’s enterprise Compliance Technology function. This role will focus on enabling, enhancing, and scaling compliance programs through technology solutions, data analytics, and system integration across global operations.

This position will support internally developed applications as well as third-party platforms (e.g., SAP GTS) and will play a key role in advancing compliance automation, reporting, and data-driven risk management. - Translate regulatory and compliance requirements into system capabilities, business rules, and functional specifications.

What is the experience needed to be successful in this role?
- Bachelor’s degree in business, information systems, data analytics, compliance, or related field required

Additional Key Skills and Knowledge
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex data sets.
- Experience with data visualization and reporting tools. (e.g., Power BI, Tableau)
- Familiarity with data platforms and architecture. (e.g., Snowflake, SQL-based environments)
- Understanding of system integration concepts, data flows, and process automation
- Experience with Excel (advanced), Power Query, or similar tools for data transformation.
- Ability to translate business and regulatory requirements into technical solutions.

JOB SUMMARY

The Trade Support Team Classification Senior Analyst provides EU HTS (European Union Harmonized Tariff System) and EU Dual use/Export Control Number (ECN) classifications of Jabil products and services and will provide information on import duties and license information to all Jabil’s European sites, their business units, logistics teams and customs brokers. Carry out internal classification audits, internal trainings, participate in classification related projects.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
·         Define HTS and ECN classification of finished goods, raw materials and other products
·         Manage, sort, partition, enter, extract or add IM/EX data items into/from the SAP/GTS (Global Trade Services) database, into/from an MS Excel spreadsheet tool or other databases as required
·         Research part and product technical characteristics from other Jabil departments, using SAP tools, customer or vendor websites, general internet searches, and other database searches to support IM/EX classifications assigned
·         Assist and support the Regional & Global Trade Compliance team with performing trade compliance audits, reporting, and other related regulatory trade compliance responsibilities
·         Carry out internal training of HTS or ECN classification related topics
·         Participate in HTS or ECN classification audits and projects
·         Assist and support the preparation, submittal and reporting on the status of license applications, binding rulings, BTIs and relevant authority communication
·         Interpret HTS or ECN classification legislation changes
·         May perform other foreign trade related classification tasks

JOB QUALIFICATIONS
KNOWLEDGE REQUIREMENTS
·         Experience in a Customs & Classification Environment.
Bachelor´s degree is essential.
·         Working knowledge of the European Union Harmonized Tariff System (TARIC), and working knowledge of the European Union Dual Use Regulations (ECN)
·         Proficiency in use of personal computers, Microsoft Office products (Excel, Word and PowerPoint) and e-mail skills required.
·          Solid communication skills in English.
Strong communication and customer service capabilities
·         Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.
·         Ability to write and follow complex correspondence. Read and understand visual aid.
·         Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out complex instructions.
·         Ability to deal with non-standardized situations.
·         Ability to read and comprehend complex instructions, correspondence, and memos.
